description:
How a coin's derivatives market is positioned, across venues, now or over a window: funding rates, open interest, liquidations by side, long/short ratios, and optionally predicted funding, basis and volume leaders. Liquidations are totalled per venue and side on the server. Example: {"asset":"BTC"} or {"asset":"ETH","window":"7d","metrics":["funding","open_interest","basis"]}.

Costs 4 credits; each optional metrics entry (predicted_funding, basis, volume_leaders) adds 1. Every section carries its own source receipt (provider, fetched_at, runtime_status); a section that fails is listed under missing and never guessed.

metrics.description: Default: funding, open_interest, liquidations, long_short. Optional: predicted_funding (Hyperliquid), basis, volume_leaders (Hyperliquid).

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data (default) or 'markdown' for human-readable text.

venues.description: CCXT exchange ids for live funding, default ["binance","bybit","okx","bitget"].

window.description: "now" (default: latest values and the last 24h of liquidations), "24h", "7d", "30d", or a start date (YYYY-MM-DD). History comes from the Hive Archive.

name: market_positioning
title: Market Positioning
